claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings (multilingual-e5 center_projected) are COMPLEMENTARY to TF-IDF citation hybrids (PRIMARY) for the product's multi-view map. They excel at: (1) Citation Heritage Recovery (AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), minimal scale ~130k; (2) Section Cross-lingual Alignment (Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy), full corpus BLOCKED; (3) Linear Hybrid Complement (PASS adversarial at 19yr+ w=0.3-0.4, adds cross-lingual benefit but JP < TF-IDF baseline). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. No single representation dominates LangDom+JP+CiteIndep at any scale. TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (JP 0.78); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY. Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping + parquet 2022-2026 + section extraction. Corpus lane resumption required for 174k completion. No further same-question cycles justified.
evidence_summary: Independent verification of all primary claims at 22yr/144k scale: (A) Citation heritage AUC 0.792-0.795 (cp64/raw) > 0.75 threshold ✅, 344 positive pairs; (B) Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp64=0.282 (>0.2) ✅, Dispositiv cp64=0.150 (>0.1) ✅, Erwaegungen cp64=0.094 (<0.1) ❌ — center projection improves all gaps 16-38%; (C) Linear hybrids PASS both adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP=0.61-0.67 remains below TF-IDF baseline 0.78-0.79; (D) Dense center_projected FAILS jurist gate at ALL scales (3yr: 0.39-0.42, 15yr: 0.288, 19yr: 0.369, 20yr: 0.048, 22yr: 0.427); (E) Legal TF-IDF on bge_ corpus (6.2k) FAILS 6-8/14 benchmarks — corpus mismatch (bge_ vs bger_ IDs, signal coverage deficits); (F) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all 6 scales tested. Fundamental blockers: no bger_ corpus 2000-2019, no bge_↔bger_ ID mapping, no 2022-2026 parquet (29.5k decisions), no section extraction at 174k. All evidence files accessible and metrics reproducible.
